cs.t: 'Many home users print less than a page a week on average.' I am a one-man business and home user, printing on average less than this. I've used the sama canon inkjet printer for several years and changed the ink maybe twice in this time. Recently though, while staying with my dad, I bought another cheap inkjet partly because he needed a printer too and it would be useful for when ever I was there. I made the mistake of buying a 'Google Cloud-print' compatible printer since my dad uses a Chromebook. I have to say that thing has put us both through hell and is the worst purchase I have ever made.
cs.th: There is no good reason to buy an inkjet printer (2016)
